from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u025/system/state/workspace/programs')
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def _runs(indices, edge_values, background):
    runs = []
    start = None
    for i, value in enumerate(edge_values + [background]):
        if value != background and start is None:
            start = i
        elif value == background and start is not None:
            runs.append((start, i))
            start = None
    return runs


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    def cast_line(vertical, fixed, direction, color, marker_color):
        # fixed is a row for a horizontal beam, or a column for a vertical beam.
        length = w if not vertical else h
        positions = range(length) if direction > 0 else range(length - 1, -1, -1)
        for p in positions:
            r, c = (p, fixed) if vertical else (fixed, p)
            value = out[r][c]
            if value == marker_color and ((not vertical and c in (0, w - 1)) or (vertical and r in (0, h - 1))):
                continue
            if value == background:
                out[r][c] = color
            else:
                # A non-background interior cell is the target. Mark it and stop.
                if (not vertical and c not in (0, w - 1)) or (vertical and r not in (0, h - 1)):
                    out[r][c] = 4
                break

    def process_pair(vertical):
        # Edge runs on opposite sides; offsets within the runs pair the beams.
        if vertical:
            a = _runs(range(h), [grid[r][0] for r in range(h)], background)
            b = _runs(range(h), [grid[r][w-1] for r in range(h)], background)
        else:
            a = _runs(range(w), grid[0][:], background)
            b = _runs(range(w), grid[h-1][:], background)
        for (a0, a1), (b0, b1) in zip(a, b):
            for offset in range(min(a1-a0, b1-b0)):
                ia, ib = a0+offset, b0+offset
                # A target on either line activates this pair of beams.
                def targets_at(index):
                    cells = []
                    if vertical:
                        cells = [grid[index][c] for c in range(1, w-1) if grid[index][c] != background]
                    else:
                        cells = [grid[r][index] for r in range(1, h-1) if grid[r][index] != background]
                    # Edge marker pixels are outside these interior scans.
                    return cells
                ta, tb = targets_at(ia), targets_at(ib)
                if not ta and not tb:
                    continue
                color = (ta or tb)[0]
                # Each beam starts at its boundary run and travels toward the opposite edge.
                if vertical:
                    cast_line(False, ia, +1, color, grid[ia][0])
                    cast_line(False, ib, -1, color, grid[ib][w-1])
                else:
                    cast_line(True, ia, +1, color, grid[0][ia])
                    cast_line(True, ib, -1, color, grid[h-1][ib])
    process_pair(True)
    process_pair(False)
    return out
'''
